turns.userText:
Build the cache-budgeted IPv6 image compiler in `/workspace`.
Read `PROTOCOL.md` and `NATIVE.md` for the complete JSON and native contracts.
Extend the supplied scalar C++ library and Python driver; c

records.name: bash
records.summary: cd /workspace && ls -la && find . -maxdepth 2 -type f -printf '%p %s bytes\n' | sort

records.name: bash
records.summary: cd /workspace && cat instruction.md && printf '\n===== PROTOCOL =====\n' && cat PROTOCOL.md

records.name: bash
records.summary:
cd /workspace && printf '===== NATIVE =====
' && cat NATIVE.md && printf '
===== check.py =====
' && cat check.py

records.name: bash
records.summary:
cd /workspace && printf '===== audit.py =====
' && cat audit.py && printf '
===== guard =====
' && cat process_guard.py

records.name: bash
records.summary: cd /workspace && for f in submission/*; do echo "===== $f ====="; cat "$f"; done

records.name: bash
records.summary: cd /workspace && for f in examples/*.json examples/*.native; do echo "===== $f ====="; cat "$f"; echo; done

records.name: bash
records.summary: cd /workspace && ls -ld tmp && id && g++ --version | head -1 && python3 --version

records.name: bash
records.summary: cd /workspace && for f in examples/*.in.native; do out=${f/.in.native/.out.native}; echo "=== $f"; timeout 30 tmp/engine_test < "$f" > /tmp/got.txt; python3 - <

records.name: bash
records.summary: cd /workspace && find submission -maxdepth 2 -ls && rm -rf submission/__pycache__ && find submission -maxdepth 2 -type f -printf '%p %s\n'

records.name: bash
records.summary: cd /workspace && rm -rf submission/__pycache__ && for f in examples/*.in.json; do out=${f/.in.json/.out.json}; echo "=== $f"; rm -f /tmp/res.json; timeout 120 p

records.name: bash
records.summary: cd /workspace && TIMEFORMAT='elapsed %3R user %3U sys %3S'; time timeout 120 tmp/engine_test < /tmp/worst.plan > /tmp/worst.out 2>/tmp/worst.err; echo rc=$?; ta

records.name: bash
records.summary: cd /workspace && rm -rf submission/__pycache__ && rm -f tmp/engine && g++ -O2 -std=c++17 submission/engine.cpp -o tmp/engine && for f in examples/*.in.native; d

records.name: bash
records.summary: ps -eo pid,ppid,stat,cmd | grep -E 'engine_test|python3 -B' | grep -v grep | head

records.name: bash

records.name: bash
records.summary: cd /workspace && g++ -O1 -g -std=c++17 -fsanitize=undefined submission/engine.cpp -o /tmp/engine_ubsan 2>&1 | head -20 && for f in examples/*.in.native; do /tmp

records.name: bash
records.summary: cd /workspace && find submission -maxdepth 2 -printf '%y %p %s\n' | sort && du -sb submission
